49-2707-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Walk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

3476-4247-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1477-2122-6972.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Mindless Automaton.
When Mindless Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

2034-5189-7426-7741.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
2034-5189-7426-7741.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Shang-Chi.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1298-1618-2440-3019.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Ovika triggers, creating a number of creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token for each trigger.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.

141-3168-7301.description:
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Urza's Incubator.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
Repeat from step 3.

457-1329-3338-6289-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

372-4050-6767.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1445-4871-5632-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5632-6798.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token and a Clue token
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1353-1718-3327-4535-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1353-1718-3327-4535-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

4968-5902-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
4968-5902-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

1491-2757-4029-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2757-4029-6218.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pheres-Band Tromper, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1477-2201-2558-5687.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat.

864-1987-4377-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
864-1987-4377-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

586-997-5626-5687.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

5803-5889.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa does not have summoning sickness.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
5803-5889.description:
Cast Great Train Heist by paying at least {2}{R}{R}, choosing its first mode and optionally its second and/or third modes.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Great Train Heist.
Resolve the copy of Great Train Heist, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one if it is your combat phase, along with any other mode(s) that were chosen.
Repeat from step 3.

4321-4659-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4321-4659-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue and a Food artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food or Clue, adding {C}{C}.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

1365-1651-2034-5086.notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-2034-5086.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Triskelavus persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Triskelavus, adding {C}{C}.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Triskelavus' first ability twice by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from it, creating two 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Triskelavus and a Triskelavite, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Triskelavite tokens, you may sacrifice them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1636-4481-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Heavy Arbalest attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4481-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, targeting any target.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 1, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1858-3581-5195.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}, targeting Kykar.
Kykar and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve View from Above, giving Kykar flying until end of turn and returning View from Above to your hand.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {R}.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1636-3691.notablePrerequisites:
Cybernetica Datasmith does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature that can tap to add {U}.
1636-3691.description:
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Cybernetica Datasmith by paying {U} and tapping it, causing a player to draw a card and another player to create a 4/4 Robot creature token.
The Robot enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

500-1887-3035-4688-4751.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nadier.
500-1887-3035-4688-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
The Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve each Verdurous Gearhulk trigger, putting sixteen +1/+1 counters on Nadier.
Kill Nadier, triggering its ability, creating at least nineteen 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.
